$comment: Changelog: v1. Initial shared SIEM log event schema for ingestion, storage, and detection.
title: SIEM Log Event
description: Normalized log event contract shared by the SIEM ingestion and detection pipeline.

log_id.description: Primary key for the log event. Implementations may generate a positive auto-incrementing integer or a UUID.

timestamp.description: The event time in strict ISO 8601 date-time form, including a UTC designator or numeric timezone offset.

source_ip.description: IPv4 address of the system that produced the event.

endpoint.description: Application endpoint or resource associated with the event.

user_agent.description: User-agent or client identifier reported by the source.

action_status.description: HTTP response status code. Values must be integers in the standard 100-599 HTTP status range.

raw_line.description: Original unparsed log text retained for debugging and troubleshooting.

severity.description: Optional detection-rule tag describing the event severity.
